title: History
intro: How temperatures, heat recovery and fan levels have changed.

chart.powerHint: Above zero the unit warms the fresh air, below zero it cools it.

live.title: Live
live.note: Records only while this page is open: one reading every 10 seconds, for up to 6 hours. Reloading the page clears it.

last24.title: Last 24 hours
last24.note: Quarter-hour means. Today is kept in the unit's memory and starts again after a restart; earlier days are on the SD card.

day.emptyBody: The unit keeps a day on the SD card from the night after it was recorded.

month.emptyBody: The unit writes one record per day, just after midnight. The first day appears the day after the update.
month.range: Lowest, mean and highest quarter-hour mean of each day.
month.partialNote: Partial days (the unit started, restarted or got its clock that day) are marked ◐ and count only the recorded hours.

stats.degreeDaysHint: G20/15: for each day with a mean outdoor temperature below 15 °C, 20 °C minus that mean.
stats.efficiencyHint: (supply − outdoor) ÷ (extract − outdoor), from quarter-hours with the fans on, the bypass closed, no frost protection and at least 5 K between outdoor and extract air.

load.unsupported: This firmware doesn't record a history yet.
load.unreadable: The unit sent history data this page can't read. Update the web interface together with the firmware.
load.emptyBody: The unit records quarter-hour means; the first appears 15 minutes after it starts. Today's values are kept in memory and start again after a restart.
